result.topic_en: Riemann examines the local behaviour of a minimal surface at a point (branch points, curvature, how the tangent plane cuts the surface, the branching of the Gauss map onto the sphere) by expanding coordinates in powers of Y, and begins treating a boundary formed by a straight line.

methods.what: Local analysis at a point: place origin at the point, x-axis along the surface normal, and expand functions in positive integer powers of Y
methods.quote:

senkrecht

methods.what: Generic case: expansion of X begins with the second power, so the tangent plane divides the surface into 4 quadrants (saddle)
Relation between dX/dY and the Gauss-map variable η
At a regular point η ~ Y, so the map of the surface to the sphere is unbranched
Higher-order contact: if X begins with Y^n, the tangent plane cuts the surface into 2n alternating parts; orders of η and du/dlogY
Branch point of the Gauss map onto the sphere at such a point

Kugel hat einen $(n-2)$ fachen Verzweigungspunkt.

methods.what: Straight-line boundary lies in the tangent plane; real part of X vanishes on both sides along the boundary
